relationships.subject: Vincristine
relationships.evidence_quote: It also increased in the levels of TNF-α (Tumor necrosis factor-α), IL-6 (Interleukin-6), and MPO (Myeloperoxidase).

relationships.subject: Punica granatum fruit rind extract
relationships.evidence_quote: Administration of PFE (100 and 300 mg/kg, p.o.), EA (50 mg/kg), and gabapentin (100 mg/kg) attenuated Vincristine-induced behavioral and biochemical changes significantly

relationships.subject: Bicuculline
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment of bicuculline (selective antagonist of GABAA receptors) reversed antinociceptive action of PFE

relationships.subject: GABA
relationships.evidence_quote: administration of γ aminobutyric acid potentiated the action of PFE

key_findings: PFE prevents vincristine-induced neuropathic pain in rats; effect reversed by bicuculline and potentiated by GABA, not altered by PPAR-gamma antagonist
Docking suggests ellagic acid binds GABA and PPARgamma sites and punicalagin binds TNF-alpha and IL-6
